title: Mars Taco Bars
description: A vegetarian twist on traditional taco bars, featuring gooey cheese and crunchy taco shells.
instructions: Arrange taco shells in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Sprinkle Mars cheddar cheese over the top of the taco shells.
Bake for 5-7 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
While cheese is baking, mix together taco sauce and Mexican seasoning in a small bowl.
Remove taco shells from oven and top each shell with a spoonful of the taco sauce mixture.
Sprinkle gooey cheese over the top of each taco shell.
Bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Top with bitter lettuce and bar fresh cilantro.
